tools.name: curated-sbom
tools.notes: Hand-curated CycloneDX SBOM. Component versions are traced to committed source: STM32Cube FW_L4 pack from lifu-transmitter-fw.ioc; CMSIS from cmsis_version.h / stm32l4xx.h; LwRB from Core/Src/lwrb.c; jsmn from its copyright header (the library publishes no version macro, so no version is asserted). The STM32L4xx HAL Driver and USB Device Library headers in this tree are stripped of their internal version macros, so they are pinned to the STM32Cube FW_L4 V1.18.2 pack that delivers them.

component.name: openlifu-transmitter-fw
component.description: Openwater LIFU transmitter application firmware for STM32L443: TX7332 transmit-channel configuration, trigger/pulse-train timing, AFE configuration, module manager with I2C master/slave one-wire enumeration, JSON command interface over USB CDC and UART, SBSFU bootloader hand-off.

properties.name: openwater:version-source
properties.value: git describe (injected at build time as FW_VERSION)

components.name: STM32Cube MCU Package for STM32L4 (FW_L4)
components.description: STM32Cube firmware package delivering the STM32L4 HAL/LL drivers, CMSIS device files, and ST middleware used by this project.

components.name: STM32L4xx HAL Driver
components.description: Hardware abstraction layer drivers for STM32L4. Version pinned to the STM32Cube FW_L4 pack (internal HAL version macros are not present in the committed headers).

components.name: CMSIS Core (Cortex-M)
components.description: Cortex Microcontroller Software Interface Standard core headers.

components.name: CMSIS Device STM32L4xx
components.description: CMSIS device support (headers, startup, system) for STM32L4xx.

components.name: STM32 USB Device Library
components.description: ST USB device core plus CDC (virtual COM port) class, used for the JSON command interface. Version pinned to the STM32Cube FW_L4 pack (internal library version macros are not present in the committed headers).
